content.intro: Print a Yahtzee score sheet for the table, or keep score on your phone. The sheet adds the upper bonus and grand total for you.
howToUse: Write each player's name at the top of a column. On every turn the player picks one empty box and writes the score for that roll, or a zero if the roll fits nowhere and they choose to scratch a box.

After 13 turns every box is filled. Add the upper section first: a score of 63 or more earns the 35-point bonus. Then add the lower section, including 100 for each extra Yahtzee, and add both totals for the grand total.
Playing on a phone instead? Tap a box on the sheet to write a score. Totals, the bonus and the leader update as you go, and the game is saved if the phone locks.

faqs.q: What is the bonus in Yahtzee?
faqs.a: If your upper section adds up to 63 or more, you get a 35-point bonus. 63 is what you score with three of each number, from three 1s to three 6s.

faqs.q: How many turns are in a game of Yahtzee?
faqs.a: Thirteen. There are 13 boxes and every turn fills exactly one of them, so the game ends when each player's column is full.
Once you have scored 50 in the Yahtzee box, each extra Yahtzee you roll earns another 100 points. If you put a zero in the Yahtzee box, extra Yahtzees earn no bonus.

faqs.q: Can you score a zero in Yahtzee?
faqs.a: Yes. If a roll fits nowhere you want it, you must still fill a box, so you write a zero in one. This is often called scratching a box.

faqs.q: What is the highest possible Yahtzee score?
faqs.a: Without Yahtzee bonuses the maximum is 375. With a Yahtzee bonus on every possible turn, the maximum is 1,575.

faqs.q: How many people can play Yahtzee?
faqs.a: Any number from one up. The printable sheet has six columns; the online scorekeeper takes up to ten players.
